observations: Photo 0 shows a large industrial diesel engine assembly with multiple hoses/lines, fuel system components, and an exposed cylinder head/valve cover area; no clear readable model plate.
Photo 1 shows the top/valve cover side of the engine with a large valve cover and surrounding components; again no clearly readable engine ID/model text.
The seller text says 'Complete caterpiller c9 engine (parts)'. The photos do not clearly confirm 'C9' or 'complete' status.

claims.evidence: Photos show an engine assembly, but the 'C9' model and whether it is complete (all parts included) are not clearly readable/confirmable from photo 0 or photo 1.

risks.risk: Engine model may not be C9 (wrong engine family/model), which changes parts compatibility and value.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the engine serial/model plate (or stamped ID) and the full label area on the engine block/head.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as an unknown used Caterpillar engine/engine parts set with compatibility not guaranteed.

risks.risk: Not actually complete: missing key components (turbo, alternator, injectors, ECM, wiring harness, starter, sensors, flywheel/housing, etc.). Photos only show partial assembly views.
risks.proof: A laid-out inventory photo list showing every included major component, plus a photo of the engine fully assembled end-to-end (front and rear) with all accessories present.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as incomplete engine parts (worst case: missing accessories/ECU/sensors), not as a fully usable complete engine.

risks.risk: Condition/operability unknown (may be seized, cracked, or internally damaged).
risks.proof: Video of a cold start (or at least a compression test / leak-down test results) and photos of any damage indicators (cracks, scoring, coolant/oil contamination).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as non-working/unknown condition parts (worst case: needs overhaul).

risks.risk: Parts may be mismatched or swapped (some components not original to the claimed model).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of part numbers on injectors, turbo, ECM, and major housings (with readable labels).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as used parts with reduced certainty of correct fitment.

risks.risk: Shipping/handling damage risk (engine exposed; hoses/lines and sensors can be broken).
risks.proof: Photos of all connectors/sensors/ports and a checklist of what is intact; show any broken fittings clearly.
risks.if_unproven: Priced assuming possible missing/broken small parts.

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the engine identification plate/serial/model stamping (to confirm 'C9').
Photos showing both ends of the engine (front and rear) with all accessories present, plus a photo of the full assembly in one frame.
A component-by-component list (injectors, turbo, alternator, starter, ECM/ECU, sensors, wiring harness, fuel pump, intake/exhaust manifolds, flywheel/housing if applicable).
Evidence of condition: compression/leak-down results or a start video; otherwise photos of any cracks/scoring and oil/coolant condition.
response.reason: The photos show an engine assembly, but the key pricing drivers—exact model confirmation ('C9'), completeness of included parts, and whether it is working—are not verifiable remotely from the provided images.
